rows.grounds: expresses the general rule or common case
refers to all the platforms mentioned in the ritual arrangement
fused form kvacit + anyamate; indicates an alternative authoritative opinion
marks a different arrangement or rule

items.question: Do all platforms follow a general arrangement or admit an alternative configuration in another view?
premises: A general rule applies to all platforms.
Some other authoritative view exists regarding their arrangement.
That alternative view prescribes a different configuration.
items.inference: Therefore, while all platforms are generally arranged in one way, an alternative arrangement is accepted according to another view.
uncertainties: The specific nature of the alternative arrangement indicated by anyathā is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Generally all platforms are arranged in the same way, but according to some other view they are arranged otherwise.
